name: Axiom Systems Perception Filter Rounds PFR-1 'Blind Spot'
description: Ammunition containing a micro-payload of Axiom's experimental neural perception inhibitor compound, which upon detonation releases an aerosol that temporarily disrupts the brain's ability to form new memories and process visual information within a 5-meter radius. Targets within the cloud can see, move, and act, but they cannot form coherent memories of the experience and their visual processing is scrambled — faces become unrecognizable, text becomes illegible, spatial relationships distort. The effect lasts approximately 3 minutes and leaves no lasting damage, but during that window the affected individuals are functionally blind to identity and detail. Axiom developed it for covert operations where witness elimination is undesirable but witness testimony must be neutralized.
specifications:
delivery: 40mm grenade launcher compatible
aerosal radius: 5 meters from detonation point
effect onset: 2 seconds after inhalation
effect duration: 2-4 minutes
memory disruption: Complete anterograde amnesia during exposure
visual disruption: Face/text/spatial recognition failure
weight per round: 0.22 kg
countermeasure: Sealed respiratory system prevents inhalation
story_hooks: Witnesses to a Tier 3 corporate raid all report the same experience — they were there, they saw things happen, but they cannot describe a single face, read a single badge, or recall a single detail.

Axiom's perception inhibitor compound has been synthesized by an independent chemist who is threatening to release the formula publicly — the implications for witness testimony and legal proceedings are catastrophic.
image_prompt: A single Axiom Systems PFR-1 'Blind Spot' 40mm grenade round on a matte black tactical surface, shot from a 45-degree angle. The casing is semi-transparent, frosted pewter-gray, with barely-visible crystalline payload suspension visible within. Dramatic side-lighting creates subtle iridescence across the surface and casts deep shadows. The fuse assembly is minimal and sterile. Shot in neo-noir tactical aesthetic — clean, cold, sinister. Nearby, a gloved hand (leather, worn) hovers near but doesn't touch, suggesting extreme caution. Shallow depth of field. --ar 3:2 --v 6

physical_description.visual_profile: A 40mm grenade with an unsettling translucent quality — the casing appears almost frosted or deliberately obscured, as if designed to resist visual scrutiny itself. The round sits low and squat, with a slightly bulbous midsection that suggests pressurized payload containment. There's an intentional anonymity to it; no aggressive spikes or serrations, just smooth geometric pragmatism.
physical_description.dimensions: Length: 54mm overall. Diameter: 40mm (standard launcher bore). Payload chamber: 32mm diameter.
physical_description.weight_description: Deceptively dense and cold to the touch — heavier than its compact size suggests, with a satisfying gravity that speaks to the pressurized neurochemical payload inside. Balanced, not front-heavy, designed for precise trajectory.
physical_description.primary_material: Steel pressure vessel core with a semi-opaque polymer outer casing of experimental Axiom proprietary formulation — slightly textured, deliberately non-reflective.
physical_description.finish: Matte pewter-gray with intentional micro-pitting across the surface to defeat optical recognition systems. No gloss, no shine. The casing has a sandblasted appearance that makes it appear almost weathered despite being new.
physical_description.color_scheme: Flat pewter-gray primary with deep charcoal accents around the fuse assembly. A single thin band of phosphorescent blue-gray near the base — an identifier only for infrared targeting systems, invisible to normal sight.
physical_description.grip_texture: The round itself lacks a grip; designed for secure seating in standard 40mm launcher chambers. The polymer exterior is slightly grippy, almost tacky, suggesting specialized surface treatment to prevent accidental slippage during covert insertion.
distinctive_features: Frosted, semi-translucent outer casing suggesting internal payload obscurity
Minimalist fuse assembly — no visible firing pin, suggesting electronic or contact-triggered detonation
Micro-etched industrial serial number (illegible to human eye, readable only to scanning systems)
Pressure relief valve port on the side — hairline vent barely visible
Internal payload visible as faint suspension of crystalline particulates within translucent casing
Radiating heat signature suppressant coating (appears as subtle surface iridescence under certain angles)
physical_description.manufacturer_markings: Axiom Systems logo (Φ symbol faintly etched, nearly invisible unless light catches it at specific angles) on the pressure vessel. Minimal text. Batch code inscribed with UV-reactive ink, readable only under UV light — a deliberate anti-documentation feature.
physical_description.condition_typical: Pristine, sealed, anonymous. These are manufactured to clinical specifications and maintained in airtight containment. In the field, they remain unmarked and untraceable — a ghost round designed to leave no forensic signature beyond the neurochemical residue.
